The office fill cue borrows from design-coded bullet lists and the modern work-marker aesthetic, which is exactly why the emoji reads as office coded rather than literal spiral-notepad-coded shape.

In real-world usage 🗒 lives in the spaces where the sender wants to communicate work-marker energy. A partner sends it on a 'office 🗒' work-marker marker. The office fill cue is what makes the emoji feel office coded — it is not just 'shape,' it is 'office coded spiral-notepad moment.'
